K-7.note: "dismiss" should be the leftmost button and not filled in. primary action should be filled rightmost button

K-4.note: i think this really depends on the nature of the failure and whether its blocking, resolvable, actionable, etc. non-blocking, unactionable errors should be the short floating notices. blocking issues that appear AFTER a message has been recieved and recorded to the transcript should appear in chat. blocking issues that stop the message from being sent in the first place should appear in the strip above the input area. i'd like to try to minimize the room/opportunity for these kinds of errors to appear in the first place, and better handle and make clearer things that don't work like /review in your example. if a user needs to act, it needs to be clear. if the failure is simply a known limitation of the app, this should be better explained

K-3.note: again, depends on the nature of specific errorrs. should probably include dismiss/try again buttons in most cases, and auto-dismiss in some instances on next command or message send.
